hypotheses.name: Analogue-field transfer protocol with an explicit domain-adaptation bound (Dixie Valley / Desert Peak / Brady’s)
hypotheses.status: DESIGNED ONLY; official source listings are public; data alignment, label audit, and transfer experiment NOT completed
layers: Dixie Valley fault-map files GIS_Faults.zip listed on GDR #207 (CC BY 4.0 page; inspect archive layer lineage and CRS; public-domain geoscience/well data do not prove every trace is drilling-verified)
Desert Peak–Brady preliminary geologic map, NBMG OF 03-27 official product page lists a free PDF ZIP and geospatial PDF; no GIS vector archive is confirmed on that page
GDR #1288 geothermal/non-geothermal classification dataset and covariates, including fault density (CC BY 4.0; geothermal labels are not fault-trace truth)
Only source/target features demonstrably available, geolocated, semantically compatible, and equivalently processed; do not assume analogs contain the GeoDAWN 19-band stack
hypotheses.physical_signature: Protocol, not a geological transform: estimate the HΔH domain divergence with a pre-registered balanced classifier two-sample test on a defined common representation. The Ben-David et al. bound has three terms: target error <= source error + (1/2) HΔH-divergence + λ, where λ is the joint error of the best shared hypothesis. The C2ST estimates only a divergence term; small divergence alone is not a certificate of transfer. Evaluate label-definition compatibility and λ proxies with field/site-blocked source holdouts before any target use.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Regional analog-field map material could expose structural detail not present in the GeoDAWN-area catalogue, but neither the target omission class nor cross-field label equivalence is established. GDR #207 documents a characterized Dixie Valley field and public-domain geoscience/well data; it does not establish that every map trace is drilling-verified. The NBMG OF 03-27 page links a map PDF/geospatial PDF, not a confirmed vector GIS archive.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_work: No GEMSDOE campaign in the supplied ledger has implemented and validated a source-to-target transfer using an audited off-region fault-map layer. This is a plan, not a result; H41 used catalogue-derived features.
hypotheses.expected_live_delta: Unknown; do not estimate until data/label alignment, divergence, source holdouts, and target proxies are measured.
hypotheses.cost: medium-high (acquire/extract, licence and CRS audit, map semantic normalization, common-feature construction, spatial holdout and divergence uncertainty)

hypotheses.name: Shallow thermal-probe residual lineaments x gravity edges
hypotheses.status: DESIGNED; GDR source listing is public, but probe bytes are not in the current restored working set; NOT run
layers: INGENIOUS 2 m temperature probe archive listed as a 1.03 MB download on GDR #1391 (CC BY 4.0; bytes not present in current candidate cache)
Training band 18 iso_grav_anom_hg as a candidate edge gate; band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope is a separate gravity derivative, not thermal
Optional USGS DOI 10.5066/P9BZPVUC background conductive heat-flow maps and well-point/residual field as independent context; not the 2 m probe temperature product
hypotheses.physical_signature: Interpolate/residualize shallow 2 m probe temperatures against a pre-registered regional/topographic background, then test whether coherent positive residuals co-locate with band-18 gravity edges. Treat the USGS heat-flow product as a separate corroborator, not as the 2 m residual surface.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Shallow thermal anomalies may expose fluid-flow pathways without a preserved surface scarp, but springs, land cover, elevation, season, and sampling density are confounds that need matched controls.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_work: GEMSDOE28 H35-1 (spring/well discharge-point conjunction) FAILED its far-field gate below a matched random control; H33-B uses the spatially continuous 2 m probe field and a residual-above-background definition, not discharge points. GEMSDOE28 H38-2 queued this idea but never ran it (data gate)
hypotheses.expected_live_delta: Unknown until probes are fetched, their sampling/season metadata are audited, and spatially blocked proxy validation is run.
hypotheses.cost: medium (data ingest, spatial bias controls, residual construction, and proxy validation)
